  "decision": "fail",

  "summary": "This headmotion2 acquisition shows a mutually reinforcing pattern of provenance-confirmed large rotation, elevated image blurring, reduced SNR across tissue classes, and poor tissue segmentation overlap, consistent with significant head motion degradation.",

    "large_rot_frame",

    "large_rot_frame=true (provenance warning) — scanner-level detection of a large rotation frame directly confirms significant head motion occurred during acquisition.",
    "fwhm_avg=4.58, percentile=95.6 — image spatial blurring is at the extreme high end of the reference population, consistent with motion-induced blurring.",
    "snr_gm=12.00, percentile=28.7 and snr_wm=16.08, percentile=11.9 and snr_total=10.55, percentile=22.5 — SNR is reduced across all tissue classes, with WM SNR near the bottom decile; high-evidence metrics supporting motion-related signal degradation.",
    "efc=0.598, percentile=76.8 — elevated entropy focus criterion indicates increased ghosting or blurring consistent with motion artifact.",
    "tpm_overlap_csf=0.164 (percentile=1.3), tpm_overlap_gm=0.457 (percentile=3.1), tpm_overlap_wm=0.510 (percentile=4.4) — all three tissue class overlaps are in the bottom 5th percentile, indicating severely degraded tissue segmentation alignment consistent with motion-corrupted anatomy."
  ],
  "recommended_followup": [
    "Visually inspect the scan for motion ringing, ghosting, or blurring artifacts to confirm the automated findings.",
    "Review snrd_gm and snrd_wm (both >90th percentile) in context — the high background-referenced SNR relative to low tissue SNR may reflect an unusual background noise distribution; verify air mask validity.",
    "Consider excluding this scan from downstream structural analyses given the convergent motion evidence.",
    "If the motion was intentional (headmotion2 paradigm), confirm whether this scan is expected to fail and document accordingly."
  ]
}
